languages.text: Python was my first programming language and remains one of my strongest. I primarily use it for data analysis, automation scripts, and solving complex algorithmic problems. I am comfortable with libraries like pandas, NumPy, and matplotlib, and I often leverage Python to prototype projects quickly or handle real-world data challenges.

C# is my go-to language for developing robust, production-level applications. I have experience building desktop applications, automating workflows, and structuring large-scale projects with clean, maintainable code. Its object-oriented features and integration with .NET make it ideal for professional-grade software.

JavaScript is essential for modern web development, and I am proficient in writing efficient, readable, and maintainable code. I have used it to create interactive web applications, implement dynamic UI features, and follow best practices such as ES6+ syntax, asynchronous programming, and modular design. My formal education and practical projects ensure solid competence with JavaScript.

HTML is the backbone of every website I build. I have a strong understanding of semantic markup, accessibility standards, and structuring content for clarity and SEO. I use HTML to create clean, organized layouts that serve as a reliable foundation for CSS and JavaScript enhancements.

CSS allows me to transform HTML structures into visually appealing, responsive designs. I am proficient in flexbox, grid, animations, and responsive media queries. I focus on writing clean, maintainable styles and strive to create polished UI experiences that are consistent across browsers and devices.

I use Bash and the terminal extensively for automation, system management, and scripting tasks. I am comfortable writing scripts to automate repetitive workflows, manage files, and interact with Linux environments. While I’m still exploring advanced shell scripting techniques, I am confident in using Bash for practical, efficient solutions.

I have experience with relational databases like MySQL, writing queries, designing schemas, and optimizing data retrieval. Additionally, I have explored NoSQL databases such as Firebase, giving me flexibility in handling structured and unstructured data. I enjoy structuring data efficiently and ensuring the integrity and performance of database-driven applications.

Java is a language I enjoy for building object-oriented applications and experimenting with cross-platform solutions. I have implemented small projects, such as console apps and simple GUIs, and appreciate Java’s structured approach to software development. Its versatility makes it an excellent alternative to C# for production-level work.

Go is a language I explored for its speed, simplicity, and concurrency support. I built my first useful CLI tool in Go, which searches websites efficiently from the terminal. While my experience is limited compared to other languages, I enjoy Go’s clarity and its suitability for high-performance applications and networked services.
